title: APIForge vs Swagger Editor: Feature & Usability Breakdown
description: Factual comparison between Swagger Editor and APIForge for OpenAPI spec parsing, live testing, SDK generation, and quality scoring.
heroSubtitle: Modern Intelligent Workbench vs Classic OpenAPI Editor
verdict: Swagger Editor is the classic tool for editing YAML files with standard Swagger UI preview. APIForge builds upon this by adding AI-powered schema auto-fixing, zero-CORS proxy request execution, automated test generation, and deterministic quality scoring.

sections.title: CORS Handling in Live API Testing
sections.description: When testing APIs from Swagger Editor in the browser, requests fail if the target server lacks Access-Control-Allow-Origin headers. APIForge includes an integrated CORS proxy server so you can test any API spec without CORS errors.
sections.apiforgeWay: Routes requests via secure server proxy
sections.competitorWay: Direct browser fetch subject to CORS failure

faqs.question: Does APIForge support both OpenAPI 3.0 and Swagger 2.0?
faqs.answer: Yes, APIForge parses, converts, scores, and tests both Swagger 2.0 and OpenAPI 3.0 specifications seamlessly.
